info.title: MICROSERVICE-apiwizruntimedoc-List Realestate Listings Agents-v4-spec
info.description: The Real Estate Listings by Agent API enables users to access comprehensive information about real estate listings associated with specific agents. This endpoint allows consumers, such as real estate agencies and property platforms, to retrieve valuable data on available properties, including details like pricing, location, and features. By leveraging this API, developers can enhance their applications with dynamic real estate content, helping to inform buyers and optimize the property search process. The API is particularly beneficial for real estate professionals looking to showcase their listings and attract potential clients.

get.summary: Retrieve listings by a specific agent.
get.description: This endpoint allows users to fetch all property listings associated with a specified agent. It provides detailed information about each listing, making it easier for potential buyers or renters to explore options managed by their desired agent.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve agent listings based on specified parameters. It should contain the necessary criteria for filtering the listings.
